conditions: The API must be used when you need to pass a user's consent status to AppLovin SDK
The flag must be set before the AppLovin SDK is initialized
User's consent status must be collected and managed correctly and responsibly
Adherence to GDPR regulations when using this API
The app is responsible for complying with applicable privacy regulations
effects: The API allows passing the users' consent status for interest-based advertising

If a user consents to the collection and use of their personal data for interest-based advertising, their consent status is respected for the lifetime of the application or until the user revokes consent
If a user does not consent to the collection and use of their personal data for interest-based advertising, this state is respected for the lifetime of the application or until the user consents

conditions: "true" when the user gives consent for data collection, "false" when the user does not give consent
effects: In the log, the "Has User Consent" value is displayed as "true" or "false" accordingly
